scope: Fixed original Stage95 QA identities; geometry feasibility only; 0 fit/pretraining/test payload/full extraction

geometry.reference: ml/configs/spatial.yaml; FASERNU-04 SCTTopLevel-02; verify observed z residuals

identities.reference: Stage95 cohort.qa exact 40, entries from QA_events.tsv

point_policy: All points retained without deduplication/truncation. Signed x/y=-1/-999 not blindly removed. Nonfinite, all xyz=-999, abs coordinate=999999 or unsupported z flagged; no graph silently dropping them.

edge_policy.neighbors: directed both ways between adjacent nominal layers within each station only

mask_QA.hidden_plane: 3 + original row % 9; all nine nominal downstream planes allowed including empty observed collections
mask_QA.target: 257 observed-count bins: 16x16 XY cells of 25 mm on [-200,200)^2, plus overflow
mask_QA.visible_input: Visible coordinates/plane identities/edges/counts only; none of the original62 scalars, total point count, hidden count/moments or labels
mask_QA.probe: Alter hidden XY and append two hidden points; visible inputs must be byte-exact unchanged

admission: Pilot first source with path, original QA entries only; conservative CPU/wall factor5 +30s, bytes factor3; fixed40 expansion only if below caps. Shared pre-read byte cap and CPU hard caps apply.
acceptance: 37/40 original identities readable, all 40 accounted for; no new unexplained missing source
7 branches align; exact run/event and |delta leading pz0|<0.0002GeV
Every readable original point finite and mapped within10mm; no points truncated
Every edge station/adjacent-plane valid and nearest-distance brute-force max error<1e-10mm
Permutation exact; masked coordinates/count perturbation leaves visible input exact; target sum exact
Measured costs within stated caps; complete summary required
physics_limit: Observed SpacePoint collection counts, not active-strip efficiency, pure noise, unique particles, or track association. True geometry conditions/readout/TSOS/covariance remain unverified.
